description.p: Lexicon is a small, native dictionary utility for KDE Plasma. It looks up English words in a local SQLite dictionary and presents definitions in a focused popup.
The application is offline-first, starts without a visible window, and is intended to stay out of the way until invoked by a global shortcut or the tray icon.
Stage 1 is a scaffold: global shortcut and command-line lookup work, while automatic retrieval of selected text on Wayland is still a documented proof of concept.
Initial scaffold with configuration, SQLite lookup, KGlobalAccel registration, tray integration, and QML popup.
